prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Talan Slipshot. Character visual motifs: rugged surveyor with mechanical ricochet bow-rifle, rangefinder eyepieces and foldable brass mirror drones; no blink and giant piercing beam.
TOP LEFT: Proof Mark. Ability concept: a direct skillshot hit stamps the target with one Proof Mark for 4 s; marks improve the next reflected shot slightly, one proc per target.
TOP RIGHT: Set Mirror. Ability concept: places one thin 2-HP projectile reflector at a selected ground point; at most 2 mirrors exist, facing fixed direction.
BOTTOM LEFT: Evidence Shot. Ability concept: fires a single bolt that may ricochet **once** from one mirror at the previewed angle. Direct and reflected hits deal different capped damage; walls stop shots.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Closed Case. Ability concept: chooses one visible target and displays three **public** predicted lines from existing mirrors for 0.8 s. Fires along the selected legal line for high damage; remaining lines are decoys clearly labeled as possible routes. No global shot or aimless auto-hit.
